identitySignals: Agenda names 'Stuart Foundation' as the funder of a grant for a Learning Lab at Oakland International High School; the Stuart Foundation of San Francisco is a private foundation whose stated mission is public education for young people in California

The foundation's own site gives its name as 'Stuart Foundation'; a third-party funder profile (Hinchilla) identifies it as 'Stuart Foundation (Elbridge Stuart Foundation)' with EIN 20-0882784 and the same 500 Washington Street address, and ProPublica lists Elbridge Stuart Foundation, EIN 20-0882784, in San Francisco, CA
The foundation's own newsletter (March 2023) discusses the Linked Learning approach in Oakland Unified, showing it follows OUSD's education work
research.notes: Legal name per IRS/ProPublica is Elbridge Stuart Foundation, operating as Stuart Foundation (DBA link confirmed via third-party profile hinchilla.com, not cited). The agenda text gave no location and no page directly confirmed the OIHS Learning Lab grant; identity rests on name, registry, and mission match. CA entity number and SAM UEI not searched.

profile.summary: The Stuart Foundation is a private foundation based in San Francisco. It makes grants to help young people through public education. Its work focuses on California schools and, more broadly, on well-resourced and inclusive public education systems.

review.notes: Cited sources confirm the Stuart Foundation's San Francisco address, phone, and mission, and ProPublica confirms Elbridge Stuart Foundation (EIN 20-0882784) as a 501(c)(3) private foundation; a search result (GuideStar: 'Elbridge Stuart Foundation DBA Stuart Foundation') links the two names. A California education funder fits a Learning Lab grant at Oakland International High School, though no source directly confirms that specific grant.
